decisions.reason: A core piqué upholstery fabric with its own page, launched in 2023, typically stays in an interior textile collection for several seasons.
The trend-driven bouclé-effect sheer fits the core curtain business, but its lower web presence makes it somewhat more vulnerable in a collection refresh.
Flame-retardant curtain fabrics meet steady contract and hospitality demand and often stay in the range for many years.
The wool-blend double-face fabric is still young, but the move away from hard-to-recycle blends adds moderate risk of removal.
The renewable wool bouclé leno matches the sustainability direction and is too recent to withdraw.
The newest launch has its own page and serves both upholstery and curtain uses, so it will likely remain.
